answer: Proof of Stake prevents Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as a ledge against malicious behavior. Like a comet tracking across a celestial grid, the network uses a decentralized beacon to randomly select validators proportional to their staked wealth. An attacker attempting to flood the system with fake identities must incur the prohibitive cost of acquiring enough assets to control the consensus weight, rendering the marginal utility of additional identities net negative.
